verdict.rationale: Crossplane documents reusable package types (Providers, Configurations as "portable packages of Crossplane resources", and Functions). Its official CLI supports building, installing, updating and pushing those packages, and the site promotes "a library of components to assemble your platform faster", which covers both consuming and publishing modules. missing for 10: explicit documentation naming a public registry or marketplace and how discovery works there, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the publish/consume workflow.
